1.0.2.summary: OpenGL-first canvas rendering with uninterrupted signal flow, live pulse animations, log flood rate limiting, and Modern UI refinements
changes: OpenGL-first canvas: default to hardware acceleration for fluid drop shadows, cable glow, and 25 FPS signal-flow pulses without artificial throttle profiles
Signal flow & audio pulse fix: resolved ctypes pointer unwrap in libpulse read callback so PipeWire/PulseAudio peak meters reliably feed node pulsing and travelling line pulses
Log flood rate limiting: terminal log output capped at 60 lines/sec and UI log flushes batched (100ms) to stop high-frequency debug floods from freezing the UI thread
Modern UI default layout: side panel and canvas meters hidden by default in modern mode; floating toolbars and minimap anchored to the patchbay container
Settings dialog modernization: declarative 2-column layout with SettingsFormBuilder, sidebar icon separation to preserve native typography, and PipeWire external client mode preservation

installation.flatpak: Download/run the Flatpak bundle: `flatpak install --user com.github.acropolis914.Clara.flatpak`
installation.ubuntu: Download `.deb` and run: `sudo dpkg -i clara-ubuntu-*.deb && sudo apt-get install -f`
installation.fedora: Download `.rpm` and run: `sudo dnf install clara-*.rpm`
installation.nix: Run directly via Flake: `nix run github:acropolis914/Clara`

1.0.1.summary: CI now builds portable AppImage and Flatpak bundles alongside deb/rpm/tar/nix, plus documentation and packaging fixes
changes: GitHub Actions packaging workflow extended with x86_64 AppImage and Flatpak jobs, wired into the release asset set
Standalone AppImage builder (bundled CPython + PyQt6/Qt6) for modern systems
Flatpak manifest + bundle against the org.kde.Platform 6.8 runtime
README and installation guide document the AppImage, Flatpak and clara/carla naming
clara is the primary binary/desktop name; carla remains a backwards-compatible symlink

1.0.0.summary: Clara 1.0.0 - patchbay overhaul: modal navigation, pluggable routing/arrange, animated signal flow, Catppuccin theming, and AppImage/Flatpak packaging
changes: Animated signal/event flow: travelling pulses along cables with comet tails and per-node glow driven by real engine levels (plugin peaks + external/PipeWire peak-detect via libpulse)
Patchbay search relocated into the top context toolbar, with persistent Ctrl+F selection and a restyled (Catppuccin blue) results dropdown
Pluggable routing engine: self-contained A* + flocking router and a new orthogonal (Manhattan) router, both obstacle-aware
Pluggable arrange algorithms: heuristic (pattern-aware) and Sugiyama layouts alongside classic/flow, selectable and persisted (Canvas/ArrangeStyle)
Graph introspection model (patchcanvas/graph_info.py) as the foundation for scripting/claractl
Major canvas performance pass: multi-second freeze on settings apply with pure-Python routers cut to a few hundred ms
Catppuccin theming across patchbay, settings and search; sidebar tabs and buttons use Nerd Font glyphs, legacy bitmap icons/options removed
Modal (Photoshop/Blender-style) canvas navigation, infinite canvas, marquee selection and minimap tracking
Session safety: rotating autosaves, countdown timers, dirty-edit tracking and save-on-exit prompts
New distribution targets: portable x86_64 AppImage and Flatpak builds (clara primary, carla kept as a backwards-compatible symlink)
